Question Choices: Track Runners: Runner A laps a track in 75 seconds, and Runner B laps it in 105 seconds. If they start at the same time, when will they next meet at the starting line?
Hints: Find the least common multiple (LCM) of the two lap times;Prime factorize both numbers to find the LCM
Solution: To find when they meet next, we need the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 75 and 105. Prime factorization: $75 = 3 \times 5^2$ and $105 = 3 \times 5 \times 7$. LCM = $3 \times 5^2 \times 7 = 525$. They will meet in 525 seconds.
